question: Will the 12-month change in the U.S. core PCE price index, excluding food and energy (BEA, seasonally adjusted; computed from the index) for February 2025 (the latest monthly reading dated on or before 2025-02-14) be below 2.70%?

rule.threshold_basis: a round number near the lower quartile of historical moves over the same distance

source: Source: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis
